description: BESOO (Online Building Energy Simulation and Optimization) is a set of online programs that calculate room temperatures, Heat Index and related values for apartments under given designs and climate conditions. It is written by Joseph Nowarski; version 511 (1.1.1, HTML and PHP) was archived on Zenodo in 2025 and the program runs free without login at nowagreen.com/BESO. This version works without heating or air conditioning: for a chosen building orientation, in 22.5-degree steps, it computes wall layer temperatures, room air temperature with optional ventilation, the Heat Index, the hours per year at comfort temperature, and the Thermal Time Constant. Coverage: climate input files for Jerusalem (lower humidity, colder winter) and Tel Aviv (moderate temperatures, higher humidity). Access: online program, with source and climate CSV files on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 on Zenodo; free. Caveats: a single-author tool; the validation basis is not given in the record. Simulation uses: choosing insulation position and thickness and concrete thermal mass to limit indoor heat stress in unconditioned homes. Related records: the Modelblocks European building heat data and the Bolzano monitoring dataset.
